Docs.summary: Provides non-cryptographic CRC and xxHash algorithms for byte input.
Docs.remarks: CRC-32, CRC-64, XXH32, XXH64, XXH3, and XXH128 support incremental calculations through NonCryptographicHashAlgorithm and complete-input calculations through static methods. CRC-32 byte results use little-endian order; the other algorithms here use big-endian order.
